name: Yuma, Proud Protector
oracle_text:
This spell costs {1} less to cast for each land card in your graveyard.
Whenever Yuma enters or attacks, you may sacrifice a land. If you do, draw a card.
Whenever a Desert card is put into your graveyard from anywhere, create a 4/2 green Plant Warrior creature token with reach.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a Desert card is put into your graveyard from anywhere, create a 4/2 green Plant Warrior creature token with reach.

needs.what: a trigger event that fires for each card matching a filter (here: subtypes ["Desert"], owner = you, i.e. into YOUR graveyard) put into a graveyard from ANY zone -- battlefield (sacrificed or destroyed Desert), hand (discard), library (mill, surveil), stack -- one trigger per card, not batched
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has no generic zone-change-to-graveyard event: leaves_battlefield with to_zones ["graveyard"] and dies/sacrificed see only permanents leaving the battlefield and miss discarded and milled Desert cards; discard covers only the hand; leaves_graveyard is the opposite direction. Same capability already filed for sand_scout and turntimber_sower. The other two lines are expressible today: cost_reduction {"count": {"zone": "graveyard", "owner": "you", "types": ["Land"]}}, and self_enters / attacks triggers whose effect is a may with pay {sacrifice: a land} then draw 1.

needs.what: a 4/2 green Plant Warrior creature token with reach
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has no Plant Warrior token; the only Plant is plant_0_1_g and the reach tokens are spider_1_2_g_reach and wall_0_3_c_defender_reach, all different tokens
